updateChannel.analysis: package.json publish = GitHub, releaseType draft; app-update.yml has no channel. updates.ts never sets allowPrerelease, so installed stable copies (0.6.6) run with electron-updater 6.8.9's default allowPrerelease=false and GitHubProvider resolves /releases/latest, which GitHub never answers with a draft or prerelease. Current latest release: v0.6.6. An rc build itself sets allowPrerelease=true (prerelease current version) and could later move to a newer prerelease or stable; it never downgrades (allowDowngrade false).
